CLIP (with atom IDs): E02.001 | 00:00.00-00:04.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Mara as the lamp flickers behind them.
E02.002 | 00:00.40-00:03.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
[Hard cut]
E01.006 | 00:10.00-00:13.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Corin toward the widow.
E01.007 | 00:10.40-00:12.80 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (silken, venomous) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E01.008 | 00:13.00-00:18.00 | CAM | Close-up on Mara's hands gripping the rail.
E01.009 | 00:13.40-00:16.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (nervous, cold) | "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
E01.010 | 00:18.00-00:23.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Corin as the lamp flickers behind them.
E01.011 | 00:18.20-00:23.00 | ACT | Corin kneels on the slick quay boards.
E01.012 | 00:18.40-00:21.06 | DLG | SELENE (panicked, cruel) | "Mother will see you hang for this."
E01.013 | 00:21.50-00:23.00 | SFX | Glass shatters on stone.
E01.014 | 00:23.00-00:29.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Corin's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E01.015 | 00:23.40-00:27.96 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (urgent, kind) | "The boat leaves at the turn of the tide. Be on it."
E01.016 | 00:29.00-00:35.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Tobin toward Mara.
E01.017 | 00:29.40-00:32.82 | DLG | MARA (tender, defiant) | "If I say yes, the harbour keeps its tongue."
E01.018 | 00:35.00-00:40.00 | CAM | Low angle on Mara framed against the lighthouse beam.
E01.019 | 00:35.20-00:40.00 | ACT | Mara grabs the Mayor by the wrist.
E01.020 | 00:35.40-00:38.82 | DLG | CORIN (dangerous, protective) | "Say her name again and you will regret it."
E01.021 | 00:40.00-00:46.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E01.022 | 00:40.40-00:44.58 | DLG | CORIN (low, cold) | "I came back for one reason, and she is standing here."
E01.023 | 00:46.00-00:48.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Tobin as the lamp flickers behind them.
E01.024 | 00:46.20-00:48.00 | ACT | Tobin slaps the cup from the Mayor's hand and it shatters.
E01.025 | 00:48.00-00:51.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on the Mayor's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E01.026 | 00:48.40-00:50.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (nervous, pompous) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
